v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.en: All ye nations * shout unto God with the voice of joy.

text.la: Inténde * voci oratiónis meæ, Rex meus et Deus meus.
text.en: Hearken to the voice * of my prayer, O my King and my God.

text.la: Deus maiestátis * intónuit: afférte glóriam nómini eius.
text.en: The God of majesty * hath thundered, ascribe to the Lord glory to his name.

text.la: Laudámus nomen tuum * ínclitum, Deus noster.
text.en: O God of majesty, * we praise thy glorious name.
O praise the Lord, * all ye nations. ‡

text.la: Beátus vir, qui invéntus est sine mácula, et qui post aurum non ábiit, nec sperávit in pecúnia et thesáuris. Quis est hic, et laudábimus eum? fecit enim mirabília in vita sua.
text.en: Blessed is the rich man that is found without blemish: and that hath not gone after gold, nor put his trust in money nor in treasures. Who is he, and we will praise him? for he hath done wonderful things in his life.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths.

r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God.

text.la: Nolíte sollíciti esse * dicéntes: Quid manducábimus aut quid bibémus? scit enim Pater vester quid vobis necésse sit.
text.en: Take no thought, saying: What shall we eat? * or: What shall we drink? For your Father knoweth what things ye have need of.

text.la: Deus, qui beáto Caietáno Confessóri tuo apostólicam vivéndi formam imitári tribuísti: da nobis, eius intercessióne et exémplo, in te semper confídere et sola cæléstia desideráre.
text.en: O God, who didst give grace unto thy blessed confessor Cajetan to order his life on the pattern of thine Apostles, grant unto us through his prayers, and after his example ever to put all our trust in thee, and to seek only heavenly things.

text.la: Qui odit ánimam suam in hoc mundo, in vitam ætérnam custódit eam.
text.en: He that hateth his life in this world, shall keep it unto life eternal.

v.en: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree.

r.en: He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

text.la: Deus, tuórum glória sacerdótum: præsta, quǽsumus, ut sancti Martyris tui et Epíscopi Donáti, cuius festa gérimus, sentiámus auxílium.
text.en: O God, Who art thyself the glory of thy priests, grant unto us, we beseech thee, to feel the help of thine holy martyr and bishop Donatus, whose Feast we are keeping.
